integrity_notes: The exact norms and second-order conclusions are analytically proved in the accompanying manuscript. Numerical checks are diagnostic and are not independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Only the two axial characters in each coordinate on ternary/quaternary groups and the corresponding torus frequencies are covered.
The asymptotic signed comparison is not an effective finite-dimensional threshold.
The full text of a closely relevant 2026 nonbinary Hamming projection paper was inaccessible, leaving bibliographic priority uncertainty.
title: A residue-class second-order law for axial Fourier projection constants
